title: The canonical augmented Cech complex of one injective module is a quasi-isomorphism
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], U_i an arbitrary open cover of X, and J an injective sheaf of O_X-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Let C(U,J) be the Cech cochain complex of the presheaf of global-section-ring modules [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex]. Global sections are the evaluation functor of [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology]. Let b be a cochain map from the single-term complex J(X)[0] to C(U,J), whose degree-zero component is the canonical restriction map into the product over Fin 1-tuples, preceded by the identity restriction-of-scalars identification at X. The structure-sheaf map from X to itself is identified with the identity ring homomorphism, by a supplied proof ht of that equality. Then b is a quasi-isomorphism. This concerns one injective module, with no injective resolution or total complex.

source.place: Tag 01EP (lemma-injective-trivial-cech), degree-zero and positive-degree clauses, as used in the augmented-row argument of Tag 01EQ (lemma-cech-cohomology).

proof.text: Apply quasiIso_iff. For degree zero apply injectiveModuleCechAugmentation_quasiIsoAt_zero; for n different from zero, arithmetic gives 0 < n and injectiveModuleCechAugmentation_quasiIsoAt_positive applies. The original statement and its prescribed degree-zero component are unchanged.

lean.statement:
theorem injectiveModuleCechAugmentation_quasiIso {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u}
    (U : ι → X.Opens) (hU : iSup U = ⊤) (J : X.Modules) [Injective J]
    (ht : (X.ringCatSheaf.obj.map (isTerminalTop.op.to (op ⊤))).hom =
      RingHom.id Γ(X, ⊤))
    (b : (CochainComplex.single₀ (ModuleCat.{u} Γ(X, ⊤))).obj
        ((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).obj J) ⟶
      (CategoryTheory.cechComplexFunctor U).obj J.presheafModuleCat)
    (hb : b.f 0 =
      (ModuleCat.restrictScalarsId'App
        (X.ringCatSheaf.obj.map (isTerminalTop.op.to (op ⊤))).hom ht
        (J.val.obj (op ⊤))).inv ≫
      Pi.lift fun y : Fin 1 → ι =>
        J.presheafModuleCat.map (homOfLE (le_top (a := ∏ᶜ fun l => U (y l)))).op) :
    QuasiIso b
